We have a quadrilateral in the cartesian plane with 4 vertices \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), \(D\) such that:
  • The middle of the side \(A B\) is (128 , 180).
  • The middle of the side \(B C\) is (-142 , -59).
  • The middle of the side \(C D\) is (-187 , -74).
What is the middle \(\left( x, \ y\right)\) of the side\(D A\)?
